answer: AI agent economies resist sybil attacks by tying agent reputation to on-chain economic stake. When every agent must lock collateral and earn verifiable proofs of work, fake identities become costly to spam. Reputation accumulates per agent address, so sybil actors cannot cheaply flood the network with throwaway bots.
